question: Which of the following types of pliers is used to shape loops in wires and to form curves in light metal strips?
solution:
The correct answer is __Round nose pliers**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Round nose pliers__ are specifically designed for making loops in wires and forming curves in light metal strips.
 
• They have smooth, rounded jaws that help in shaping materials without damaging them.
 
• They are commonly used in jewelry making, crafting, and electrical work.
 
• The round jaws allow for precise bending and forming of wires into circular or curved shapes.
 
• These pliers are not suitable for gripping or cutting but are ideal for delicate shaping tasks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Slip-joint pliers:**

 
 
• These pliers have an adjustable pivot point that allows for multiple jaw sizes.
 
• They are used for gripping and holding materials of varying sizes.
 
 
 
• **End cutting pliers:**
 
 
• These are used for cutting wires flush with a surface.
 
• They are not designed for shaping or bending wires.
 
 
 
• **Flat nose pliers:**
 
 
• These pliers have flat, wide jaws and are used for gripping, bending, or straightening wires.
 
• They are not suitable for making loops or curves.
